spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is a real photo of the man's apartment building entrance; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Morning outside the entrance of a modern high-rise residential building in Sanchong, based on image 3: a wide entrance canopy clad in dark textured stone above glass doors, white-framed upper floors, two leafy street trees, a few scooters parked at the curb, a quiet sidewalk. The man walks out of the glass doors onto the sidewalk with his backpack on, heading off for the day. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
